paite: Aw, Israel inkote aw, na kiang ua TOUPA thugen ngaikhia un,
heading: Milim Biakna Leh Biakna Dik
english: Hear the word which Yahweh speaks to you, house of Israel!

paite: TOUPA'N hichi in achi: Namte omdan ching kei unla, van a chiamtehnate ziak in leng lunglau sam kei un; huaite ah namte lunglau in a-om nak uhi.
english: Thus says Yahweh, “Don’t learn the way of the nations, and don’t be dismayed at the signs of the sky; for the nations are dismayed at them.

paite: Mite dante bangmah lou ahi ngal a, Gamnuai ah sing aphuk ua, heipi a mikhutsiam khut in asep ahi.
english: For the customs of the peoples are vanity; for one cuts a tree out of the forest, the work of the hands of the workman with the axe.

paite: Dangkasik leh dangka-eng in azem ua, atatlouhna ding in sikkilhna leh sek in akilh uh.
english: They deck it with silver and with gold; they fasten it with nails and with hammers, that it not move.

paite: Tangmai huan a vasa lauh ding milim bang ahi ua, apau thei kei uh. Amau apai theih louh ziak un, puak suan akiphamoh sek uh; amaute lau kei un, thil sia ahihthei kei ua, thil hoih leng ahihthei sam kei uh.
english: They are like a palm tree, of turned work, and don’t speak: they must be carried, because they can’t go. Don’t be afraid of them; for they can’t do evil, neither is it in them to do good.”

paite: Aw TOUPA, nang bang kuamah a-om kei ua, na thupi a, na min hatna in athanglian hi.
english: There is none like you, Yahweh; you are great, and your name is great in might.

paite: Aw namte Kumpipa, kua'n ahia hon kihta lou ding? Huai lah na tuakzou him ngal a. Namte mipil tengteng lakte ah, alalgam lak uah leng, nang bang mahmah a-om kei uh.
english: Who should not fear you, King of the nations? For it appertains to you; because among all the wise men of the nations, and in all their royal estate, there is none like you.

paite: Amau khawksak nei lou mihai ahi ua, manna bei sing milimte sinsak ahi uhi.
english: But they are together brutish and foolish: the instruction of idols! it is but a stock.

paite: Tarshish a kipan dangkasik sek ahon la ua, Uphaz a kipan dangka-eng, mikhutsiam bawl, dangka-eng sekmi khutsuak, puansilh dumpuang leh sandup, mikhutsiam khutsuak vek ahi uhi.
english: There is silver beaten into plates, which is brought from Tarshish, and gold from Uphaz, the work of the artificer and of the hands of the goldsmith; blue and purple for their clothing; they are all the work of skillful men.

paite: TOUPA bel Pathian tak ahi, Pathian hing tangtawn Kumpipa ahi, aheh in lei aling a, namte'n ahehna anangzou kei uh.
english: But Yahweh is the true God; he is the living God, and an everlasting King: at his wrath the earth trembles, and the nations are not able to withstand his indignation.

paite: Akiang ua hichibang a na chih ding uh ahi: Pathian, lei leh van bawl hiloupi lei a kipan amangthang ding ua, van nuai a kipan amang vek ding uh.
english: You shall say this to them: The gods that have not made the heavens and the earth, these shall perish from the earth, and from under the heavens.

paite: Athilhihtheihna in lei abawl a, apilna in khovel atungding a, alemtheihna in van akaipalh hi.
heading: Pathian Pahtawina La
english: He has made the earth by his power, he has established the world by his wisdom, and by his understanding has he stretched out the heavens:

paite: A-aw asuah chiang in, van ah tui aging honhon a, kawlmong a kipan meipi akahtousak a, vuah zukna ding in khua aphesak a, agoubawm a kipan huih anungsak hi.
english: when he utters his voice, there is a tumult of waters in the heavens, and he causes the vapors to ascend from the ends of the earth; he makes lightnings for the rain, and brings forth the wind out of his treasuries.

paite: Michih amawl ua, theihna anei kei uh, dangka-eng sekmi in alimsek azumpih a, amilim sun lah zuau lel ahi a, amau ah hinna leng a-om kei hi.
english: Every man has become brutish and without knowledge; every goldsmith is disappointed by his engraved image; for his molten image is falsehood, and there is no breath in them.

paite: Bangmah lou ahi ua, khemna nasep lel, agawt hun chiang un amang ding uh.
english: They are vanity, a work of delusion: in the time of their visitation they shall perish.

paite: Jakob tantuan bel hichibang ahi kei, thil tengteng bul ahi ngal a; Israel agouluah nam ahi a, amin sepaihte' TOUPA ahi.
english: The portion of Jacob is not like these; for he is the former of all things; and Israel is the tribe of his inheritance: Yahweh of Armies is his name.

paite: Aw nang, um a om lellel in, lei a kipan na puanthuah lakhawm in,
heading: Hong Tung Ding Saltanna
english: Gather up your wares out of the land, you who live under siege.

paite: TOUPA'N hichi in achi: "Ngai un, tu in gam a tengte ka singkhe ding, aphawk tham un ka hihgenthei ding."
english: For thus says Yahweh, Behold, I will sling out the inhabitants of the land at this time, and will distress them, that they may feel it.

paite: Ka natna ziak in ka tung agik hi, ka liamna ana a, himahleh, "Hiai hial haksatna ahi, ka thuak mai ding ahi," ka chi.
english: Woe is me because of my hurt! my wound is grievous: but I said, Truly this is my grief, and I must bear it.

paite: Ka puanin aseta, ka khau tengteng akitat vek a, ka kiang a kipan ka tate apawt ua, a-om nawn kei uh; ka puanin kaipalh ding a- omta kei uh, ka puanzak hon lepsak ding.
english: My tent is destroyed, and all my cords are broken: my children are gone forth from me, and they are no more: there is none to spread my tent any more, and to set up my curtains.

paite: Belamching mite amawl ua, TOUPA thudotdan athei kei uh; huaiziak in alamzang kei ua, abelamhonte uh adalhzak khinta.
english: For the shepherds are become brutish, and have not inquired of Yahweh: therefore they have not prospered, and all their flocks are scattered.

paite: Ngai un, mallam a pan husa ahong tung, buaina thupi mahmah, Judah khopite hihgawp in, sehal tenna ding a suaksak ding in.
english: The voice of news, behold, it comes, and a great commotion out of the north country, to make the cities of Judah a desolation, a dwelling place of jackals.

paite: Aw TOUPA, mihing omdan bel, amah thu lel ahi kei chih ka theita hi; mihing akalsuante ama kipi hilou hi.
english: Yahweh, I know that the way of man is not in himself: it is not in man who walks to direct his steps.

paite: Aw TOUPA, hon thunun inla, ahun lel in, heh lou in, huchi lou in zaw na hon hihmang kha ding hi.
english: Yahweh, correct me, but in measure: not in your anger, lest you bring me to nothing.

paite: Nang hon thei ngeiloute tung leh na min lou ngei lou namte tung ah na hehna bungkhia in; Jakob ane khin ua, ahi, ane khin ua, anemang ua, atenna gam ahihsia uhi.
english: Pour out your wrath on the nations that don’t know you, and on the families that don’t call on your name: for they have devoured Jacob, yes, they have devoured him and consumed him, and have laid waste his habitation.
